results.title: Roads around Kirtipur cricket ground to be blacktopped within three months
results.content: The Kathmandu Road Division has invited bids for upgrading 1.5km of access roads at an estimated cost of Rs69.8 million, ahead of international cricket tournaments.

results.title: Janakpur bowlers restrict Karnali to 132
results.content: Captain Harmeet Singh takes three wickets as Karnali Yaks lose nine wickets in their 20 overs in the Nepal Premier League.

results.title: Kathmandu Valley to consume 5.18 million flower garlands this Tihar
results.content: Domestic growers are expected to meet nearly 89 percent of demand as the festival’s flower trade, including plants and potted chrysanthemums, approaches Rs645 million.

results.title: Nepali lawmaker faces privacy backlash over videos of children filmed with smart glasses
results.content: Ashika Tamang blurred a child’s face after criticism, but rights advocates say her videos raise wider questions about consent and the responsibilities of elected representatives.

results.title: The NPL is on, but fans in Achham can’t get a signal
results.content: As the tournament unfolds in Kathmandu, supporters in remote villages are travelling to nearby settlements and market centres to watch their teams.

results.title: Nepal gives 35 days to agency owners yet to respond to arrest warrants
results.content: The Department of Foreign Employment warns of banking and travel restrictions for those who fail to report, as it investigates Malaysia’s selection of 25 Nepali recruitment agencies.

results.title: How Pakistan’s NOC rules are affecting the Nepal Premier League
results.content: A reported $25,000 clearance demand has disrupted team plans, leaving franchises uncertain about the availability of seven Pakistani players signed for the tournament.

results.title: Nepal’s historic loss and damage allocation falls short of its needs
results.content: The UN fund has provisionally set aside 21.6 million for Nepal after the Rasuwa disaster, marking a first while covering less than 0.5 percent of the country’s estimated $4.7 billion recovery and reconstruction needs.

results.title: Nepal plans first feasibility study for Himalayan tourism highway
results.content: The proposed routes would connect Badimalika in the west and Pathibhara in the east, with a six-month study to assess costs, environmental impacts and possible road alignments.

results.title: She climbed Everest without supplemental oxygen. But the summit was never the point
results.content: Melissa Arnot Reid, the first American woman to achieve the feat, launched her memoir in Kathmandu, reflecting on shame, self-worth and the people behind Himalayan expeditions.

results.title: Oli, Dahal move to extend alliance to next year’s local and provincial polls
results.content: UML and Nepali Communist Party leaders are exploring grassroots-level electoral cooperation to prevent further erosion of left-wing support.

results.title: Xtreme is betting on Nepali sport. It’s helping both — for now
results.content: A Nepali energy drink is now sponsoring national cricket team players, seven NPL franchises, and the country’s first franchise volleyball league. But nobody will say how much it is paying.

results.title: Nepal, India to discuss border security at annual meeting this week
results.content: The three-day talks will focus on cross-border crime, human trafficking, drug smuggling, boundary management and intelligence sharing along the 1,751-kilometre open border.

results.title: Nepal seeks talks with Malaysia over recruitment of Nepali workers
results.content: Kathmandu has proposed a meeting in November or December to discuss Malaysia’s foreign worker recruitment system and renew a labour agreement signed in 2018.

results.title: Why Kathmandu is drinking blind
results.content: A technique that maps aquifers from the air is changing how countries protect their drinking water. Nepal needs to adopt this method.

results.title: Nepal Premier League’s third season kicks off with Lumbini bowling first
results.content: Defending champions Lumbini Lions won the toss and elected to field against Sudurpaschim Royals in the opening match of the eight-team tournament at Kirtipur.

results.title: Tatopani border closure disrupts trade and livelihoods after brief reopening
results.content: Only 72 cargo containers entered Nepal during a brief reopening. With the crossing shut again, traders face dwindling stocks and local businesses are struggling to survive.

results.title: Most Nepal government websites back online after PHP2Shell flaw
results.content: Officials say security patches have restored thousands of government websites, but some public portals and applications remain inaccessible
